author: MuchLax
quote: GTA 6 represents everything wrong with the video game industry today. $80+ for a code in a box, no physical ownership, graphics over gameplay, 10+ year development time, and astroturfed critic acclaim. The graphics and NPCs are improved compared to GTA 5, but that is to be expected when GTA 5 was released over 13 years ago. Surprisingly, GTA 5 ran smoother on a PS4 than GTA 6 on a PS5, which runs at an unstable 30fps on all consoles. The gameplay needed to be revolutionary for the ridiculous amount of time and hype, but it is functionally the same as previous entries if not watered down and sterilized. Out of principle, this game deserves to be rated as low as possible because it is a shameful example for the industry and should not be held as the new standard. The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time was revolutionary for it's time, and deserved that 99 score. GTA 6, on the other hand, does not.
